keyFormat: GOOD (Genshin Open Object Description), matching Irminsul exports

conventions.sets4.tier: 1 = best in slot, 2 = good alternative, 3 = fallback
conventions.sets2: Each entry is a pair of 2pc category tokens (see setCategories). 'any' = any set, i.e. off-piece-friendly. Listed only where 2pc+2pc is a common build (Nilou, Vodyanitsa, Illuga before C2, Shenhe, Mona, Zhongli shielder); empty means the build wants a 4pc.
conventions.mainStats: Acceptable main stats per slot, ranked best first. Flower is always hp, plume always atk. '*' = any main stat acceptable.
conventions.avoidMainStats: Main stats that look on-element but are useless for this build (e.g. elemental DMG goblets on Lunar/Stellar reaction scalers). Score these as unacceptable.
conventions.confidence: verified = researched from 2025-2026 sources; consensus = long-standing community builds, not re-checked; speculative = thin data, double-check
conventions.enabled: false = exclude from leveling decisions by default

scoringDefaults.notes: Score = sum of a matching build's substat weights over the piece's starting substats (include unactivatedSubstats for 3-liners). A build matches if the set is in sets4 or the set's 2pc category appears in sets2, and the main stat is acceptable for the slot.

builds.notes: KQM quick guide 4.0, Hyperbloom: ER (until requirements) > EM > CRIT Rate (Favonius) > HP%, with EM or ER sands and EM goblet and circlet. Her Burst heals on Max HP, but KQM marks the pure HP healer 'Not Recommended' because her healing is enough when built offensively. ER with Favonius at C6: 160-180% as a solo-Electro driver, 120-140% with a second Electro; as an off-field support 180-220% and 140-160%; 20-40 points more without Favonius. Raiden in the team lowers it by 40-60%, Fischl by 30-40%. ER sands until the need is met, then EM sands. Noblesse, or Deepwood when no Dendro teammate holds it; Flower of Paradise Lost falls behind those team buffs (KQM). CRIT Rate circlet with Favonius Greatsword

builds.notes: Shieldbot is 'by far the most recommended playstyle' (KQM quick guide 7.1); GameWith and GenshinBuilds (7.2) build him the same way. Shield scales on HP alone. ER: KQM sets no requirement for the shielder; GameWith and GenshinBuilds rank it after HP. 2pc HP + 2pc HP gives the strongest shield (KQM) and suits when someone else holds Tenacity. Tenacity 4pc is GameWith's and GenshinBuilds' pick, though the Stele's range limits it (KQM); Archaic Petra in Hydro teams (Neuvillette, Mualani) where he picks up the shard (KQM, GenshinBuilds); 4pc Instructor (4★) for Lunar-Crystallize. No damage build: KQM says his personal damage isn't worth investing in, and for a damage build it still ranks ATK over HP
